title: SavedSearch
description: A Guardian saved search. It is the source of a ScheduledReport, an AlertTrigger, or a DetectionRule with searchRef. The text is compiled when it is saved, so a search that does not compile is refused. The tenant always comes from the caller's token. A tenant keeps at most 500. Deleting one that a ScheduledReport or AlertTrigger still uses is refused.

displayName.description: The name the console shows. Defaults to metadata.name.

mode.description: dsl: the Guardian search language. sigma: a Sigma rule's detection, run as a search.

text.description: The search, in the language mode names.

rangeMs.description: How far back the search reads when it is opened or run by hand, in milliseconds: 1 minute to 30 days.
